name: JOKER IMP
effect: +5 points on every scoring play.

name: VAMPIRE IMP
effect: After scoring, drain one played monster species' enhancement for your side this round. Gain +3 on future plays per drain, for this match.

name: COWBOY DOOMGUY
effect: +4 per Bullet monster you play.

name: LUCKY IMP
effect: 25% chance of +20 on each scoring play.

name: GREEDY JOKER
effect: +6 extra per Gilded monster you play.

name: PROFESSOR REVENANT
effect: Every third March you play upgrades your March bonus by +5 for this match.

name: MAGICIAN ARCH-VILE
effect: +15 when you play John Romero in a valid combination.

name: PIRATE CACODEMON
effect: +12 when extending a centre started by your opponent.

name: SLEEPY MANCUBUS
effect: Each draw/pass stores +4, up to +16. Your next scoring play collects it.

name: KING CYBERDEMON
effect: +10 if a Cyberdemon remains in your hand after playing. Once per play.

name: DISCO REVENANT
effect: Repeat the leftmost played card's enhancement: Gilded +4, or Charged +8 on extension.

name: CHEF MANCUBUS
effect: Each Fire monster played adds +1 to future Fire-play bonuses, up to +20, for this match.

name: MIME DOOMGUY
effect: Copy the previous slot's fixed scoring bonus. Cannot copy Mime, chance, stored growth, multipliers or extra actions. Swap your slots by clicking them.

name: BOXER PINKY
effect: +12 when you add exactly two cards in a valid play.

name: GENERAL BARON
effect: +15 when you play or extend a named team.

name: ASTRONAUT LOST SOUL
effect: +20 when you play or extend Apocalypse.

name: ELECTRIC ARACHNOTRON
effect: +5 per Charged monster played, including when starting a combination.

name: BERSERKER DOOMGUY
effect: Multiply your tenth-turn scoring play by 1.5, rounding down. Draw/pass gets no bonus.

name: CLOWN PAIN ELEMENTAL
effect: Your first draw/pass each round draws two monsters instead of one, if available.

name: ROCKSTAR IMP
effect: +10 when your combo family differs from your previous scoring play this round. No bonus on your first play.

name: UAC COFFEE
effect: Your first scoring play each round gains +10.

name: BLUE KEYCARD
effect: +10 when you extend the centre combo by playing exactly one card.

name: EXPLOSIVE BARREL
effect: Every third scoring play while held adds +25. Progress lasts this match.

name: DEMON CONTRACT
effect: Pay 20 points each round while held, including the round acquired. Gain +6 per scoring play.

name: GLITCH DISK
effect: Your first new matching-monster pair each round gains +20: the base-score difference to three of a kind. Does not add a card.

name: AMMO BOX
effect: +2 points for each card you add to a valid combo.

name: GLUTTONOUS JOKER
effect: Playing 4 or more cards grows this Joker by +3 for future scoring plays, up to +24 for the match.

name: VALENTINE JOKER
effect: +6 for each matching monster pair among the cards you play. Three identical monsters count as one pair, four as two. Romero does not form a pair.

name: CLOWN DOOMGUY
effect: +12 when you play exactly three cards with three different damage types.

name: BUSINESS ZOMBIEMAN
effect: +2 per card left in your hand after playing, capped at +10 per scoring play.

name: BANJO ZOMBIEMAN
effect: +10 when you play or extend a March.

name: PARTY MASTERMIND
effect: +12 when you play four or more cards in one valid play.

name: PROPELLER SS SOLDIER
effect: +8 when your combo family matches the most recent scoring play by either player this round. No bonus before the round's first scoring play.

name: JOHN CARMACK
effect: Optimization: +10 when a scoring play leaves your hand empty.

name: COMMANDER KEEN
effect: Comeback: +4 on a scoring play if your round score is lower than your opponent's before playing.

name: BLOODY SMILEY
effect: Keep smiling: +6 on a scoring play if you lead the round before playing.

name: THE TWO JOHNS
effect: Romero & Carmack: +10 when you play exactly two different monsters in a valid play. The Romero wild card does not count as a monster.

name: DOOM GUY: THE BOOK
effect: New chapter: +6 the first time you score each combo family while holding this Joker each round.

name: DAIKATANA ROMERO
effect: Swordplay: +4 for each Melee monster you play. The Romero wild card does not count.

name: JESTER IMP
effect: Common: +4 when you start a new combination. No bonus for extensions.

name: GLITCH JESTER IMP
effect: +10 every second scoring play while held. Progress resets each round.

name: SCREAMING DOOMGUY
effect: Last scream: +20 on your tenth-turn scoring play each round. Draw/pass gets no bonus.

name: B.J. BLAZKOWICZ
effect: Castle Breakout: +15 when you extend a combo started by your opponent with at least one Bullet or Melee monster.
